description: Change a reminder that exists: the date field, how many days before, the time, the time zone, who gets it (written addresses, or the address in a field of each record), whether it repeats, and which records it reads (a report's, or the whole table's). The answer says in words who gets it, when and for which records.

all_records.description: Only with repeat every_day and no report: true = the person asked for EVERY record of the table, every day

date_field.description: The date field's name or id

days_before.description: 0 = on the day, negative = after it

email_field.description: A field of the table (name or id) each record's address is read from, instead of written addresses; "" takes it off

recipients.description: The whole list of email addresses ("me" = the person you are talking to); an empty list = the record's owner

repeat.description: every_day | every_week | every_month | every_year, or "" for once. every_day goes to EVERY record it reads, whatever the date: it is refused without a report

report_id.description: A report of the table (id or name): only its records are read; "" = the whole table

name: update_reminder
